title: Meal-Holic
seoDescription: A flexible meal-subscription app with plan management, delivery tracking, and personalized selection.
deck: A flexible meal-subscription app with plan management, delivery tracking, and personalized selection.

blocks.heading: A meal plan that adapts when life changes.
blocks.left: Subscription customers needed flexibility around meal selection, skips, delivery timing, and plan changes.
blocks.right: The mobile experience made recurring orders understandable while keeping the daily decisions lightweight.

blocks.quote: The complete process, screens, and outcomes will be added through the CMS.
